headline: South Sudan sets presidential election for February 2027
summary: South Sudan rescheduled its inaugural national general election to Feb 11, 2027, extending voter registration through Nov 28 amid opposition boycotts.
why: Electoral stability in South Sudan is essential for petroleum extraction and sub-Saharan African stability.

impacts.name: South Sudan
impacts.why: Changing election timelines affects political stability and long-term oil field operations.
